description: This Java class defines a ManagerInvocationHandler that extends InvocationHandlerBase and implements ServiceAvailabilityCheckable, providing methods to check service availability and wait for the service to become available via IPCSender.

classes.name: ManagerInvocationHandler
classes.description: A class that manages invoking operations on a service, with capabilities to check if the service is available and to wait for it.

methods.name: ManagerInvocationHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a specific manager port.

methods.name: isServiceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the service on the managed port is currently available.

methods.name: waitForServiceToBeAvailable
methods.description: Waits for the service to become available within a specified timeout.
